subject: Cy Young Award voting
query: how is the cy young award voted
title: How is the Cy Young Award voted? 30 writers, 5 spots, 7-4-3-2-1 points
answer: The Cy Young Award is voted on by 30 members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America in each league, two from each MLB city. Each ranks five pitchers, scored 7, 4, 3, 2 and 1 points, and the highest total wins. Ballots are submitted before the postseason. The 2026 winners are announced Wednesday, Nov. 11, at 7 p.m. ET on MLB Network.
body:
Writers in National League cities vote for the NL award and writers in American League cities for the AL award. Voters are recommended by their local BBWAA chapter chairman and approved by the national secretary-treasurer. A writer may not split a ballot spot between two pitchers. Because ballots are due before the playoffs, postseason games do not count. The BBWAA has posted full voting results online since 2012.

The 2026 finalists are Dylan Cease (Blue Jays), Parker Messick (Guardians) and Cam Schlittler (Yankees) in the American League, and Jacob Misiorowski (Brewers), Chris Sale (Braves) and Cristopher Sánchez (Phillies) in the National League. The same show also names the first BBWAA Relief Pitcher of the Year in each league, a new award in 2026.
in_the_news: The 2026 Cy Young Award winners will be announced on Nov. 11, 2026, on MLB Network.

faq.q: Who votes for the Cy Young Award?
faq.a: 30 BBWAA writers per league, two from each MLB city in that league.

faq.q: How many points is a first-place Cy Young vote?
faq.a: 7 points. Second through fifth place are worth 4, 3, 2 and 1.

faq.q: Do playoffs count for the Cy Young?
faq.a: No. Ballots are submitted before the postseason starts.

faq.q: Who are the 2026 Cy Young finalists?
faq.a: AL: Dylan Cease, Parker Messick, Cam Schlittler. NL: Jacob Misiorowski, Chris Sale, Cristopher Sánchez.
